hull.label: Urushi lacquer
hull.line: Black lacquer, the panels worn through to red, gold waves sprinkled over it.
hull.hint: Fire your hull at the kiln 3 times.

hull.label: Driftwood
hull.line: Wood silvered by sun and salt, its grain raised, salt dried white where the spray sat.
hull.hint: Chart 20 squares of the open sea.

hull.label: Celadon crackle
hull.line: A pale green glaze, pooled deeper in the panels, crazed all over.

hull.label: Racing teak and brass
hull.line: Varnished planks, brass fittings and rivets, a number band round the stern.
hull.hint: Pass the buoys to full power.

hull.label: Bone and obsidian
hull.line: Black volcanic glass with a cold sheen, ivory bone for the ribs and the oars.

hull.label: Festival lacquer
hull.line: A festival float's vermilion lacquer, gold clouds drifting over it.
hull.hint: Take 50 patches in the City Trial.

dye.label: The cloth
dye.line: The sail as it was woven.

dye.label: Mirth dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Mirth's colour.

dye.label: Wonder dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Wonder's colour.

dye.label: Desire dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Desire's colour.

dye.label: Grief dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Grief's colour.

dye.label: Dread dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Dread's colour.

dye.label: Gall dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Gall's colour.

dye.label: Fury dye
dye.line: The sail dyed in Fury's colour.

pattern.label: Chevron
pattern.line: A point down the sail, the way you go.

pattern.label: The feeling's motif
pattern.line: The dye's feeling's pattern, as its paint lays it on the ground (Wonder's frost, Mirth's dots ...).

pattern.label: Your kiln pattern
pattern.line: The pattern of a rare glaze you wear, fired into the cloth.
pattern.hint: Wear a rare glaze with a kiln pattern.

pattern.label: Two-tone
pattern.line: The sail halved on the diagonal, a gold seam between.

pattern.label: Waves
pattern.line: Rows of overlapping wave fans across the sail (seigaiha).

pattern.label: Sunburst
pattern.line: Gold rays fanned from a sun rising over the boom.

pattern.label: Diamonds
pattern.line: A diamond lattice, keylined in gold (harlequin).
pattern.hint: Link 5 tricks into one combo and bank it.

pattern.label: Kintsugi
pattern.line: The cloth crazed, its seams mended in gold.

pattern.label: Checker
pattern.line: A racing checker down the leech.
pattern.hint: Take gold at the Raceway 3 times.

pattern.label: Constellations
pattern.line: A night sky: the Plough, Orion and Cassiopeia.

pattern.label: Flames
pattern.line: Flames licking up from the foot.

cut.label: The lug
cut.line: The sail as it was made.

cut.label: Lateen
cut.line: A long yard raised aft, the cloth a triangle under it.

cut.label: Crab-claw
cut.line: Two spars from the tack, the cloth hollowed between them.
cut.hint: Hold a grab for 3 real seconds.

cut.label: Junk
cut.line: Battened panels, the leech bowed out.

seal.label: Your seal
seal.line: Your seal stamped on the sail, so a race reads as yours.

trail.label: Lachryma
trail.line: A wake that shines with the film.
trail.hint: Link 8 tricks into one combo and bank it.

trail.label: The hull's glaze
trail.line: A wake in your hull glaze's colour.

trail.label: Embers
trail.line: A smouldering line that glows and cools.

trail.label: Ink
trail.line: A brush stroke left on the sand, drying.
trail.hint: Win a race on a track you made.

trail.label: Starlight
trail.line: Tiny glints that twinkle out across the wake.

trail.label: Frost
trail.line: Rime that sublimates as you pass.

ribbon.label: No ribbon
ribbon.line: Nothing in the air behind you.

ribbon.label: The boost's ribbon
ribbon.line: A ribbon of light behind the board while it flares in the air.
ribbon.hint: Hold a grab for 2 real seconds.

ribbon.label: Double helix
ribbon.line: Two strands wound round your flight, rungs between them.
ribbon.hint: Hold a grab for 4 real seconds.

ribbon.label: Comet
ribbon.line: A bright head, a dust tail and an ion tail.

ribbon.label: Paper chain
ribbon.line: A streamer of the house deck's cards, a suit at a time.
ribbon.hint: Win 5 wagers on your own races.

pennant.label: The pennant as made
pennant.line: The masthead pennant in its own cloth.

pennant.label: Mirth
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Mirth go home.

pennant.label: Wonder
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Wonder go home.

pennant.label: Desire
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Desire go home.

pennant.label: Grief
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Grief go home.

pennant.label: Dread
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Dread go home.

pennant.label: Gall
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Gall go home.

pennant.label: Fury
pennant.hint: Let a spirit of Fury go home.

length.label: Long
length.line: A streamer the length of the boom.

length.label: Swallowtail
length.line: The pennant cut with a V into its fly, a regatta's burgee.

length.label: Carp windsock
length.line: A koinobori carp that fills as the wind rises.

length.label: Prayer flags
length.line: Seven little flags, the seven feelings from Wonder to Dread.

wrap.label: Pinstripes
wrap.line: Two coach lines down the flanks, meeting at the bow.

wrap.label: Roundel
wrap.line: A racing roundel on each flank: your number, 0, or your seal when you wear it on the sail.

wrap.label: Flames
wrap.line: Hot-rod flames licking aft from the bow.

wrap.label: Kintsugi
wrap.line: A seam of gold down the flanks and across the deck: the board's mends worn proudly.
wrap.hint: Wreck the board 10 times and ride on.

driftwood.hint: Photograph 3 herds from the dock's board.
